text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The second crown of the Tiara route, the 
Oaks— The spectators' attention was 
divided.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Tokyo Racecourse is 2400m... Distance 
aside, it's a seriously tough course, huh?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Judging from how the Oka Sho went, does 
Gentildonna seem more suited for miles? 
What's her experience with the course 
like?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Um... so in other words, the advantage 
goes to girls with experience at medium 
distance in Tokyo?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
I wonder. At this stage in the Classic 
period, the gap in experience is still 
quite significant. Which means—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
"She's been getting results in Tokyo, so 
Verxina looks pretty tough!"

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...is what someone was saying! We did it, 
Sis♪

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Yes...

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Huh? Aren't you happy?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
No... I've been thinking the exact same 
thing.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I'm a good match for the Tokyo course. As 
long as I run my own race, I'm confident I 
can win.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text: Kyaah♡ In that case, your big sister will—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Still, I have that person.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I won't let my guard down. I'm sure 
they'll have some kind of strategy cooked 
up—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —That strategy is unnecessary.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To adjust for the Tokyo course, I 
suggested a strategy factoring in 
positioning and stamina pacing... but she 
flatly refused.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep it in mind, but please assume 
there will never be an occasion to use it.
choice_data_list: ...I figured it'd end up like this.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: What is it? So you knew all along.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bottomless depth Gentildonna hinted at 
after the Oka Sho... I began to truly 
understand glimpses of it during our 
training.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To have the stamina to maintain the same 
speed and power she showed in the Oka Sho 
over the full 2,400 meters... Her talent 
is truly versatile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I never intended to underestimate 
Gentildonna's power. However... I hadn't 
grasped its full extent.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
All I have to do is unleash the power I 
hold... and I will win.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
What did you say to me before? That I... 
to you?
choice_data_list:
…Good, it looks like we can still keep 
some reserves.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: My. What a silver tongue you have.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It's about time.
choice_data_list:
You'll show me twice what you do in 
practice, right?

You'll show me twice what you do in 
practice, right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Are you sure double is enough? I'm going 
to aim even higher, you know."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Once everyone sees it, they'll 
understand... No, they will have no choice 
but to comprehend.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"What is true strength? Today, you shall 
learn."
